title: GDAL 3.11.5 authenticated WMS 1.3 discovery and map retrieval

source.description: Version-pinned GDAL WMS driver discovers and consumes the real resource-scoped FastAPI route over loopback HTTP with explicit test authority.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: GDAL is denied without authority, then sends the test bearer and organization headers, discovers the exact WMS 1.3 layer, and retrieves a governed PNG through the real application route.
The independent WMS driver reconstructs the exact CRS84 axis order, bbox, 256 by 256 dimensions, geotransform, and three byte raster bands.
